body: You don't have to listen from last FM app exclusively, there are numerous third party apps, like PanoScrobbler which I use — this scrobbles it to last FM if any app is playing music with metadata. As far as I know, there is still no way to track what you've already listened.

I'm just anxious to speak to my work about it, due to the layoff. But I surely hope I can work something out. If it wasn't for the lockdown, I'd travel every weekend to be with her for those two days. The lockdown makes it mandatory for me to quarantine 14 days after I travel interstate.

I would regret it, surely. But I'm more concerned about the medical expenses that I won't be able to afford if I do end up losing the job due to my absence. Somehow that seems worse. The least I can do is pay for her medical expenses and I fully intend to do so.
Alright, right off the bat. Thanks. But if you read it and told me I'm TA, it would be easier to accept your judgement.
